title: 특허법ㆍ실용신안법ㆍ의장법ㆍ상표법의시행에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1

Article 6 (Return of Documents, etc.)
Where a case referred to in Articles 2 through 5 becomes final in the Supreme Court, the Supreme Court shall, and where it becomes final in the Patent Court, the Patent Court shall, promptly forward to the President of the Intellectual Property Tribunal the documents received from the Commissioner of the Korean Intellectual Property Office or the President of the Intellectual Property Tribunal, together with authenticated copies of judgments at each instance, copies of notices withdrawing actions or appeals, and other documents stating the grounds for termination of the litigation. Provided, however, that where the litigation records of the Patent Court are bound together with the appellate trial, immediate appeal, or retrial documents, those documents shall not be returned.
